budget.classification: Layer A standalone expanded checkpoint evaluation; Layer B separate budget
budget.measurement: old dev-64 harness only; never new ranking or confirmation seeds

concurrency.evaluation_jobs: registered and serialized against training or represented as capacity jobs
concurrency.mps: hard watchdog and measured free-memory/pressure checks required
concurrency.registry_design: separately reviewed concurrent registry successor; no frozen guard changes

bootstrap.target: Exploratory expected restricted survival difference over eligible unseen environment seeds under an exchangeable-seed model; exact finite-cohort mean also reported. Bootstrap coverage approximate; no exact finite-sample guarantee.

confirmation.if_winner_differs_from_incumbent: open 2048 block once after locking winner and accepted 348 hashes; replace only if paired one-sided 95% bootstrap lower bound of mean difference exceeds zero; failure is inconclusive and ends without retry or next-best
confirmation.if_winner_is_incumbent: leave_confirmation_cohort_unopened; ranking is development selection only
confirmation.minimum_meaningful_difference: none registered; LB>0 sole rule; pilot power illustrative

evaluation.benchmark_preflight: existing old dev-64 only; never new ranking or confirmation
evaluation.determinism_preflight: two repeats old dev-64 only; same pinned backend/device/library versions across stages; independent env reset; fixed chunk order
evaluation.q1_q4_ordering: sort each model alive_frames independently; bottom/top256 means, caps included; not seed partitions
evaluation.ranking_claim_limit: nested single-lineage checkpoint selection; biased development means; no six pairwise inference

evidence_limits.confirmation: one conditional test; null inconclusive; pilot 71% power at N1024 for selected 159-frame effect illustrative only; N2048 SE scales sqrt2
evidence_limits.layer_separation: A standalone eval; B separate exploratory study; budgets not shared
parent_corrections: Three trainingpairs exploratory, not formal confirmatory;this does not block LayerA design
evidence_limits.qualification: no B/E, holdout, gate, or stage promotion claim
evidence_limits.ranking: selection-biased development only; no pairwise claims

launch_blockers: full historical per-episode training/evaluation exposure collision reconstruction and future exclusions unverified
successor evaluator/determinism audit and resource registry not reviewed
full-cap wall budget not measured or registered
Layer B source RNG inventory, exact vectors and monitoring eval budget absent
2048 confirmation conditional; unopened if 348 ranks first
controller/evaluator hashes and per-lease evidence fields must be frozen

F1.note: Define a frozen vector S_i = {env_master_seed_i, sampler_rng_seed_i, and any torch/numpy/python/env RNG stream used by training}; S_i distinct across i=1..3; S_i identical across arms A and B; set the sampler seed only AFTER verified model/Adam/RNG restore; record S_i in the registration, run identity, and receipt; verify the effective sampler seed at runtime; add S_i to concurrency.per_run.
F1.title: Sampler RNG seeds are absent from the replication seed vector

F10.note: Make cohort opening conditional on winner != 348, or justify the descriptive 348 estimate explicitly and state that the one-use block is spent. Label that branch descriptive, not confirmation.
F10.title: If 348 wins, the one-use confirmation cohort is spent on a descriptive estimate

F11.note: State that the 2-campaign registry is a separately authorized lease-registry successor and this proposal does not authorize it. Include evaluation runs in the registry or serialize them against training. Require an enforcement/watchdog on MPS breach and a measured free-memory/pressure check. State the accounting basis: the proposal says do_not_add_RSS_and_MPS for unified memory (12 GiB cap); even the ultra-conservative disjoint sum (24 GiB) plus 12 GiB headroom is 36 GiB < 48 GiB, so capacity is not the blocker. Add seed vector, controller spec sha, and eval manifest sha to per_run.
F11.title: Concurrency conflicts with the frozen single-lease guard; evaluation runs and MPS enforcement are not attributed

F12.note: Define per-candidate ordering by alive frames: bottom 256 and top 256 of that candidate's 1024 episodes, caps included, not a common seed partition and not quartiles of the seed cohort; label descriptive. Alternatively define a common seed partition and justify it.
F12.title: Q1/Q4 ordering basis is missing

F13.note: State that ranking is selection-only, the winner's ranking mean is upward-biased (winner's curse), and no pairwise ranking claim is made. State that the single winner-vs-348 test on fresh seeds needs no multiplicity adjustment because it is one test, the selection is independent of the confirmation data, and the winner is frozen before the cohort opens. Future pairwise or sequential claims require a separate alpha policy.
F13.title: Ranking selection bias and multiplicity are not labeled

F14.note: Pre-register the primary endpoint as the final update (60) for both arms. If a best-checkpoint analysis is reported, select on a disjoint validation block or a training-time metric, label it exploratory, and never select on the eval cohort used for the arm comparison.
F14.title: Replication best-checkpoint selection can contaminate the arm comparison

F15.note: Add a claim limit: the ranking is a checkpoint-selection decision within one lineage; the confirmation is valid for that decision, not for a 'method A vs method B' claim.
F15.title: Candidate set is nested lineage checkpoints, not independent arms

F16.note: Label the 64-seed 3098.125 as a selected estimate; use the confirmation estimate for reporting; do not present it as an unbiased incumbent mean.
F16.title: 348's 64-seed mean is selection-biased

F18.note: Pin one backend for all candidates and both stages; record device and library versions; run a two-repeat determinism check on one candidate before the full ranking; specify env independence/reset and fixed chunk order.
F18.title: Evaluation backend, determinism, and batching are underspecified

F19.note: Reuse the frozen 64-harness conservation/audit contract (cited in the prior seed audit) and require unknown/unavailable counts to be reported and investigated if nonzero.
F19.title: Evaluation audit fields are incomplete

F2.note: Register (a) the replication evaluation cohort (fresh reserved block, descriptive reuse of ranking-1024, or defer to a separate registration), (b) the unit = paired training seed (n=3), (c) the estimator and interval, (d) the primary endpoint, (e) the frame budget. Add these to launch_blockers until frozen.
F2.title: Training replication has no evaluation cohort, analysis unit, decision rule, or compute budget

F20.note: Clarify that 'linear' means quantile interpolation (as in numpy.quantile(method='linear')), not a normal interval; record the bootstrap code hash; consider BCa for bounded/censored data or justify percentile; state whether the target is the cohort mean or a superpopulation of seeds.
F20.title: Bootstrap description is ambiguous

F21.note: Use the observed anchors for the projection, but keep the wall limit as a separate registered budget; do not convert the 147456000 frame bound into a timing claim.
F21.title: Wall budget anchors should be explicit

F22.note: Reconcile the label before relying on it; do not treat 'outcomes unopened' as 'no B-block data exists'.
F22.title: B/E 'unopened' label should be reconciled with the prior audit flag

F23.note: Keep the contiguous blocks (easy to audit) and install the union in the training exclusion config before any environment construction.
F23.title: Contiguous disjoint seed blocks are a design strength

F3.note: Label the replication descriptive/pilot unless seeds are increased to >=5-6 per arm. Pre-register: 3 planned complete pairs; if fewer than 3 complete pairs, report descriptively only and make no interval-based claim; do not silently fall back to 2. Never bootstrap over episodes or use 1024-seed precision as the arm-comparison unit.
F3.title: n=3 (minimum 2) paired training seeds cannot support a confirmatory arm claim

F5.note: Either register the replication evaluation and training frames explicitly or defer the replication to a separate registration. State that 147456000 is not the campaign total. If the replication is evaluated on 1024 seeds, justify why episode-level precision is needed when the run-level n is 3; a 256-seed per-run cohort may suffice.
F5.title: Replication compute is not in the 147456000 frame bound

F6.note: Cite both sibling artifacts by path and hash in the proposal and manifest; require the reconciliation's minimal missing artifacts before launch; audit the derived per-episode actual_seed values and sampler draws, covering training AND evaluation exposure, completed/abandoned/in-flight; a partial collision voids the manifest (no silent seed drop). The proposal's 'training ancestry seed_ids' wording is too narrow.
F6.title: Seed-exposure proof is explicitly incomplete and not cited

F7.note: Require the throughput/benchmark sample to be disjoint from BOTH ranking and confirmation cohorts (use dev-64 or a third reserved block). Running the model on ranking seeds before the ranking opens the outcomes and contaminates selection.
F7.title: Throughput sample is only required to be separate from confirmation, not ranking

F8.note: Register the new controller: origin = 348 cumulative (expected 396), u = cumulative - origin, first new update cumulative 397 -> 3e-5, last u=60 -> 1e-5; verify 348 component fingerprints (model b106e8e1..., Adam 29108e84..., RNG 831d8fa2...) in an entry-restoration record before env construction; keep the old spec as provenance only and do not restore the old scheduler as active; preserve Adam step count; log and assert per-update group LR for both arms; record the shared first-step jump from ~2.2203e-5 to 3e-5.
F8.title: Post-Adam LR controller mechanics are underspecified

F9.note: State the MDE and treat a null as inconclusive, not as evidence of no difference. Either increase confirmation N to ~1300 (80%) or ~1800 (90%) for the pilot effect, or pre-register the ~118-frame threshold as the practical margin and justify it. Pre-register a minimum meaningful difference, not only LB>0.
F9.title: Confirmation is underpowered for the pilot 348-vs-324 gap
